data.narrative:
Quandela is a Series B quantum computing company founded by Valerian Giesz, Pascale Senellart, and Niccolo Somaschi. The quantum computing sector comprises 11 identified comparables: 3 public (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

The peer-median triangulation method is not applicable to Quandela's valuation. Of the 6 same-sector peers identified, none satisfy narrow filtering criteria: zero operate at the same stage, zero at adjacent stages, and zero fall within a comparable valuation tier. This insufficiency (fewer than 3 datapoints) precludes reliable peer-median analysis, as falling back to all-sector medians would obscure meaningful distinctions across the heterogeneous quantum computing landscape.

Given the sparse same-stage comparable set, traditional comparable company analysis cannot provide a credible valuation range at this time. A rigorous analysis of Quandela would require either: collection of additional Series B quantum computing datapoints; application of venture-stage methods (e.g., forward revenue multiples or discounted cash flow conditional on technical milestones); or deeper fundamental diligence on the company's photonic quantum architecture, competitive positioning relative to superconducting and ion-trap alternatives, and path to commercial revenue. The valuation remains undisclosed and indeterminate from available market comps alone.
